texts: mixed: the count line is the most the instruction set licenses and it does bind a stated count ("three Keepers are active"), but a plural's copular property is normally stored per member ("the Keepers are active") or as a vague count phrase ("several Keepers are active"), and neither leaves a number sitting on the group for this query to read — so the how-many form will usually come back empty. Ask for the Keepers themselves and read the count off the answers: "Which Keepers are active?"
